News.title: At least 2 dead & 34 injured after hospital goes up in flames as patients are evacuated in their bed
News.content:
HOSPITAL INFERNO At least 2 dead & 34 injured after hospital goes up in flames as patients are evacuated in their bed

AT least two people have been killed and 34 more wounded in a hospital inferno in Germany.

Police described the fire in LUP Clinic in the northern town of Ludwigslust as “highly dynamic” after deploying multiple teams to the scene.



Both fatalities are patients at the facility, local authorities confirmed.



But it is still unclear whether the two deceased were in the room together.

One person needed resuscitating, but none of the injuries are believed to be serious.

Some reports suggest the flames first started in the roof of the radiology building, while others say they broke out in a patients room.

Smoke quickly spread throughout the clinic, triggering an alarm at around 4.30am local time.

Many patients and staff were evacuated from the facility, which, according to its internet page, has 160 beds.

It is the only one in Ludwigslust, and as an acute care hospital, it provides basic and standard medical care in the region.

News.title: Man & woman dead after ‘devastating’ fire rips through home in early hours
News.content:
BLAZE HORROR Man & woman dead after ‘devastating’ fire rips through home in early hours

TWO people have died in a horror fire that ripped through their home in the early hours.

A man in his 40s and a woman in her 70s were found inside the property in North Shields following the blaze yesterday – and pronounced dead at the scene.





Another man in his 70s was also found at the house in Cragside Avenue and taken to hospital for treatment, Northumbria Police said.

Fire crews were called to the scene just after 3.30am.

Two nearby properties were evacuated.

A statement from Northumbria Police reads: “Two people have tragically died following a house fire in North Tyneside.

“Shortly after 3.30am today, we received a report from Tyne and Wear Fire and Rescue Service of a fire at an address on Cragside Avenue in the North Shields area.

“Emergency services attended the scene and a man in his 40s and a woman in her 70s were found inside the address.

“Despite the efforts of responders, both sadly died at the scene.

“The next of kin for both have been made aware.



“A man in his 70s was also found inside the property – he has been taken to hospital for treatment of injuries.

“Two neighbouring properties were evacuated as precaution, and a small cordon remains in place.

“A section of the road remains closed, and officers and will continue to carry out enquiries in the area.”

Senior Investigating Officer, Detective Inspector Barry McAtominey said: “This is an absolutely devastating incident in which two people have tragically lost their lives.

“All of our thoughts and condolences are with their family and friends at this incredibly difficult time.



“Enquiries remain at a very early stage, and with the support of our partners from Tyne and Wear Fire and Rescue Service we are determined to establish exactly what happened.

“We are asking anyone with information – no matter how small or insignificant it may seem – to come forward and share what they know.”

News.title: Driver dies after van plunges 160ft from cliff at UK beauty spot
News.content:
